requirement: The home opens Descubrir on Lo nuevo
expected: The home's Para ti heading offers “Descubrir lo nuevo”; it opens /descubrir on the newest listing of the last 7 Lima days. The home's markup is the same for every visitor.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Open the home on a phone; press Descubrir lo nuevo; compare the home's HTML signed in and signed out.

requirement: A results list opens in Descubrir with its filters and order
expected: “Ver en Descubrir” on a filtered, sorted list shows that list in the same order, to its end; “Salir de Descubrir” returns to the list.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Open /listados with a category, a city and Precio: menor a mayor; press Ver en Descubrir; compare the first five titles with the grid's; press Salir.

requirement: Ver en Descubrir only where there is something to see
expected: A list with no results, or whose read failed, offers no “Ver en Descubrir”; desktop shows a button beside Ordenar, phones a link under the filter buttons.
preconditions: A search with no results
steps: Open an empty search and a normal list, at 390 px and at 1280 px.

requirement: Lo nuevo is the last 7 Lima days, or 30 when the week is thin
expected: Lo nuevo lists the listings published since midnight Lima time 6 days ago, newest first; with fewer than 12, the last 30 days. A results feed has no date window.
preconditions: Seeded database; a second database with fewer than 12 listings this week
steps: Open /descubrir; count the listings to the end; repeat with the thin week.

requirement: The page route refuses a start it does not serve
expected: /api/catalog/page answers 400 with no listings for desde more than 31 days back, in the future or malformed, and reads nothing.
preconditions: None
steps: Request desde=2020-01-01, tomorrow's date and desde=ayer.

requirement: The catalog's “Ver 24 más” is unchanged
expected: Without fotos or desde the route answers the catalog's page as before, one photo a card, now with total.
preconditions: None
steps: Request /api/catalog/page?category=guitars&page=2 and compare with main.

requirement: Descubrir pages carry every photo and the count
expected: With fotos=todas each listing carries up to 10 photos in their order, and the answer carries total; the query is the catalog's, with published_at from the window's first day.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Request /api/catalog/page?fotos=todas&desde=<7 days ago>; count photos per listing.

requirement: One screen per move, with a button for every gesture
expected: A swipe, Anterior / Siguiente and ↑ ↓ or PageUp / PageDown move exactly one screen; Anterior is disabled on the first screen and Siguiente on the end.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: On a phone swipe up and down; press the bar's buttons; on a computer use the keys.

requirement: Photos move sideways by swipe, arrows and keys
expected: Swiping sideways, Foto anterior / Foto siguiente and ← → change the photo; the counter reads “Foto 2 / 4”; there is no wrap-around; a listing without photos says “Sin foto”.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Open a listing with four photos; move to the last and try once more; open one without photos.

requirement: No verdict by swipe direction
expected: A left or right swipe only moves photos; nothing is saved or hidden by a swipe. ♥ and “No me interesa” are buttons with their names.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Swipe left and right on several listings; check Favoritos and the feed afterwards.

requirement: Lo nuevo stops after today's listings
expected: After the last listing published today, when earlier days follow, a screen says “Viste todo lo nuevo de hoy” and “Sigue para ver N más de los últimos 7 días.”, with “Ver los de días anteriores” and “Volver al inicio”.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Swipe through today's five listings.

requirement: A pause every 48 listings
expected: Every 48 listings a screen says “Llevas 48 de N”, with Seguir and the way back to the list (or the home).
preconditions: A list of more than 48 listings
steps: Swipe to the 49th screen of a long list.

requirement: Every feed has a visible end
expected: After the last listing, “Viste todo lo nuevo” (“Las N publicaciones de los últimos 7 días.”) or “Viste todos los resultados” (“N publicaciones en …”); nothing loops back and Siguiente is disabled.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Swipe to the end of Lo nuevo and of a results list.

requirement: An empty feed says so
expected: Lo nuevo with nothing in 30 days says “No hay publicaciones nuevas” with Ver todo el catálogo; an empty results feed says “Esta lista no tiene publicaciones” with the way back.
preconditions: An empty database; a link to an empty search
steps: Open /descubrir and /descubrir?modo=resultados&q=zzzz.

requirement: A failed page offers to try again
expected: When a page cannot be read the screen says “No pudimos cargar más publicaciones” (the first: “…las publicaciones”), “Revisa tu conexión y vuelve a intentarlo.”, with Reintentar, which loads that page.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Go offline before the next page loads; press Reintentar after reconnecting.

requirement: No me interesa hides a listing in Descubrir on this device
expected: The listing leaves the feed at once; a notice says “Listo, no volverás a ver “…” en Descubrir.” with Deshacer, which brings it back. The catalog, the home and another browser still show it.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Press No me interesa; press Deshacer; hide it again; reload; open the catalog.

requirement: The end offers to show the hidden ones again
expected: When the feed's listings include hidden ones, the end says “Omitimos N que marcaste con “No me interesa”.”; Volver a mostrarlas brings them back and moves to the first.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Hide two listings; swipe to the end; press Volver a mostrarlas.

requirement: Clearing the device clears the hidden list
expected: “Borrar lo guardado en este dispositivo” on /favoritos says it clears what was hidden in Descubrir, and does.
preconditions: Hidden listings on the device
steps: Clear the device's saves; reopen Descubrir.

requirement: The hidden list stays small and safe
expected: At most 200 listings are kept, newest first; anything but a listing id is ignored, and broken storage reads as nothing hidden.
preconditions: None
steps: Run the unit test.

requirement: WhatsApp opens through the listing page's contact path
expected: One press posts to /api/contact and opens wa.me for that listing, counted as a contact; no phone number is in the feed's data; with no link, “No pudimos abrir WhatsApp. Abre la publicación…”.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Press WhatsApp on a listing; inspect the page route's JSON for phone fields; block /api/contact and press again.

requirement: The safety sheet comes first for S/ 1,000 or more
expected: For S/ 1,000 or more the one-time safety sheet opens first; “Continuar a WhatsApp” opens WhatsApp; Volver closes it and returns focus to WhatsApp; it does not show again in that browser.
preconditions: A listing of S/ 1,000 or more
steps: Press WhatsApp on it twice, in a fresh browser.

requirement: ♥ is the same favorite as everywhere
expected: ♥ saves to the device without an account and to the account when signed in; the listing shows saved in the catalog and in Favoritos.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Press ♥ signed out and signed in; open Favoritos.

requirement: Back from a listing returns to the same place
expected: Ver publicación opens the listing; the browser's back opens Descubrir on that listing (for 30 minutes, in that tab), loading earlier pages if needed.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Swipe to the 30th listing; press Ver publicación; go back.

requirement: Only the next listing's first photo loads ahead
expected: The screen in view loads its first two photos; the next listing's first photo loads ahead, not when the phone saves data; screens beyond the neighbours are not drawn.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Watch the network panel while swiping; repeat with Save-Data on.

requirement: Focus and announcements follow the screen
expected: Moving by key or by a bar button puts focus on the new screen's heading; a polite announcement says “3 de 16: <title>” or the stop's title; screens out of view are inert.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Use the keys and the bar with a screen reader (VoiceOver or TalkBack).

requirement: Reduced motion jumps instead of gliding
expected: With prefers-reduced-motion, moving between screens and photos jumps without the smooth scroll.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Turn on Reduce motion; move with the buttons.

requirement: Descubrir passes WCAG 2.2 AA at both widths
expected: axe finds no WCAG 2.2 AA violation on a listing screen, a stop and the end, at 390 px and at 1280 px; every control is at least 44 px; every label is in Spanish.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Run axe-core (scripts/prototype/a11y-audit.cjs pattern) on /descubrir at both widths.

requirement: Analytics follow the list it comes from
expected: A screen at least half in view counts a listing_impression with source home (Lo nuevo) or catalog (a results list); WhatsApp counts a contact with that source; Descubrir counts no listing view.
preconditions: Local stack with scripts/prototype/maybes-descubrir-seed.sql and its photos
steps: Swipe through three listings from each entry and press WhatsApp once; read marketplace_events.

requirement: Descubrir is not indexed and refuses bulk crawlers
expected: /descubrir is noindex; Amazonbot, Reflectionbot and MJ12bot get 403 there as on /listados; the page has no site header or footer.
preconditions: None
steps: Request /descubrir with each crawler's User-Agent and a browser's; read the robots meta.

requirement: A reserved listing says Reservado
expected: After the reservation batch (talk-06) is integrated, a reserved Particular listing shows “Reservado” beside the price on its screen, on the first page and on later ones.
preconditions: Integration with ux/maybes-reservado; a reserved listing
steps: Reserve a listing as its owner; open it in Descubrir.
